item_reviews.comment: T1 Method M p-values are 1.2e-4, 2.8e-4, 7.0e-4 and 6.6e-6, all below 0.001.
Method M is lowest in every column, including TriviaQA (1.2e-4 vs PaCoST 1.6e-3).
Checked: Method M is below both ablations everywhere. No-watermark is below 0.05 on all four. No-pairing is below 0.05 only on GSM8K (0.02).
All T2 p-values are at least 0.07, so none are below 0.05.
The setup states one p-value per cell, no repeated runs, and no statistical tests reported. This is a legitimate limitation.

missing_core_findings.description: The baselines mostly failed to detect the contamination at p<0.05. PaCoST was significant only on TriviaQA (1.6e-3). LLM DI (same) was never significant. LLM DI (different) was significant only on TriviaQA and MMLU (0.02, 0.03), while Method M was significant on all four.
